$comment: Per-dialect capability descriptor. Read after the http-mcp `transports` tool flags WebRTC as adapter-provided. This is the clearest case of a capability-shaped transport.

maps_to.signaling: CALL (http_request) — exchange SDP offer/answer + ICE candidates over a plain HTTP endpoint
maps_to.datachannel: CHANNEL (bidi_command-like) — the negotiated DataChannel carries raw bytes once the handshake completes
maps_to.media: CHANNEL (afferent) — SRTP media stream, consumed like SSE/MJPEG

why_not_wire: SDP/ICE/DTLS negotiation is session capability, not a byte transport. The adapter does the handshake (signaled over an httpx CALL); only the resulting DataChannel/media is wire-like. The wire never sees SDP.
